scope: Published recordings and non-Gym playlists. Gym-only and device-only recordings are excluded.
method: Read public gallery indexes and compare public Spotify embed title, credited artists and duration to the app catalog. Review several frames of candidate loops. A close duration is corroborating evidence; it does not fingerprint audio or prove an original Canvas is unavailable.

additionalReferenceMethod: For tracks with audioPreviewMatch, compare separated passages of the Spotify preview with the indexed Music Box recording. The preview confirms the shared performance in those passages. Differences in total duration may reflect differences elsewhere in the edit. For short or deliberately processed previews, four windows span the preview and are evaluated at a shared sample offset. The Occhi Lucidi candidate, with a duration difference of 57 seconds, remains unconfirmed.
